properties.notes: Lambeth Housing Zone site. “Construction of a new building (4 to 6 storeys) on the corner of Dorset Road and Clapham Road to provide 30 residential units (Use Class C3) with associated parking and landscape works and; improvements to the ground floor of Wimborne House including extension and conversion of the existing Caretakers room to provide a community room (Use Class D1) together with works to provide an additional entrance and refuse store. Demolition of 101 homes in Broadstone House, Sturminster House, Swanage House, Verwood House and Osmington House and the construction of new buildings arranged in five blocks (with varying heights of 3, 4 and 6 storeys and, a tower block of 16 storeys) to provide 332 new residential units (Use Class C3), up to 230sqm (Gross Internal Area) of retail floorspace (Use Class A1) and up to 325sqm (Gross Internal Area) of flexible floorspace (Use Class A1, D1, B1) and; highway works and parking layout improvements.
